regions.tonight: A mix of clear spells and scattered showers this evening, but becoming largely dry tonight. Winds will be light and variable. Cooler and fresher than recent nights with lowest temperatures of 7 to 11 degrees.
regions.tomorrow: Tomorrow will be dry and warm with spells of sunshine. Highest temperatures of 18 to 22 degrees with light to moderate westerly or variable winds.
regions.pollen: Very High on Friday and Saturday.
regions.solar_uv: High or Moderate on Friday and Saturday.
